hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // \"\""); echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "git[^|;&]*(commit|push)" || exit 0; [ -x node_modules/.bin/prettier ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund >/dev/null 2>&1; out=$(node_modules/.bin/prettier . --check 2>&1) || { echo "Blocked: prettier --check failed. Run npx prettier --write on the files below, then retry." >&2; echo "$out" | grep -v "^Checking" | head -20 >&2; exit 2; }
